findings.title: Unsupported autoescape argument prevents startup
findings.body: With installed Starlette 1.2.1, importing triggarr.web.routes raises TypeError: Jinja2Templates.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'autoescape'. triggarr/__main__.py imports this module, so the application cannot start. Although uv.lock lists an older version, Docker installs from pyproject.toml without the lock, and FastAPI is unconstrained.
findings.recommendation: Restore the explicit jinja2.Environment(autoescape=True) and pass it through Jinja2Templates(env=...), preserving escaping and compatibility.
